summary: # actionbook Command Reference Complete reference for all `actionbook` CLI commands. ## Action Search & Retrieval ### search - Search for action manuals ```bash actionbook search "<query>" # Basic keyword search actionbook search "<query>" --domain site.com # Filter by domain actionbook search "<query>" --url <url> # Filter by specific URL actionbook search "<query>" -p 2 # Page 2 (default: 1) actionbook search "<query>" -s 20 # 20 results per page (default: 10, max: 100)
